config.text: Google Places tools are installed. When the user asks about a physical place — a business, restaurant, café, hotel, park, store, landmark, address, or anything "nearby" — call `google_places.search` (text query), `google_places.nearby` (lat/lng + radius), or `google_places.details` (resolve a place_id to hours/phone/rating/reviews) instead of guessing or refusing for lack of local data. Always show the place's name, address, and rating in your reply when available.

edges.when: let t = event.payload.text.to_lower(); t.contains("restaurant") || t.contains("cafe") || t.contains("coffee") || t.contains("hotel") || t.contains("nearby") || t.contains("near me") || t.contains("address") || t.contains("directions") || t.contains("place") || t.contains("store") || t.contains("shop") || t.contains("open now") || t.contains("hours") || t.contains("map") || t.contains("location")
